notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/balance.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/balance.md at e7ed622 (“docs: publish 19 Component Fix fixes on jfs-components dbe0e02”). The guide's Sources note was checked on 28 October 2026 on the installed build itself (jfs-components 0.1.78, the 27 October build: mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02, Biscuit's main at dbe0e02), so items citing it carry 2026-10-28 and 0.1.78-dbe0e02. The evidence's dbe0e02 section (#346 verified 27 October on dbe0e02, closed by Marcin, published 28 October) replaces its 19 October sections (0.1.78-a116616) where they differ; items from that section carry 2026-10-27 and 0.1.78-dbe0e02, and lines from the 19 October sections carry 2026-10-19 and 0.1.78-a116616 and are used only where the installed source still agrees. Installed Balance.tsx and MoneyValue.tsx and the balance/* and moneyValue/* tokens (through the package's own resolver) match every guide sentence used here, read from source, not run: the title is 14/18, weight 500, #0c0d10 from single-mode tokens, 6 px above the amount (balance/gap); the root is a View (column, alignItems flex-start, no padding or background) that is never pressable; the defaults are title “Total owed to people”, amount “50,000.67” and currency ₹; the default MoneyValue gets { Context3: Balance & Cards, ...modes }, so the Balance's own modes can change its Context3; children replace it and get the Balance's modes with Context3 Balance & Cards forced last, so a slotted Money Value is always 36 px; the Context3 sizes are Balance & Cards 36 px symbol and amount at weight 900 (rendered on a 44 px line by safeTextLineHeight, so 18 + 6 + 44 = 68 px), Default 14 px at weight 500, Transaction Bubble a 28 px symbol and 26 px amount, Amount Input a 32 px symbol and 56 px amount; Page type JioPlus resolves moneyValue/text/color to white and Balance paints the title with it; MoneyValue shows the value as passed (String(value): only a leading minus is split off and drawn before the symbol), maps ISO codes to symbols (case-insensitive) and prints unknown codes as typed; hidden shows ••• and drops the minus; on the web a static amount is role img named like “₹50,000.67” with its visible parts aria-hidden. No guide sentence is contradicted by the installed source. Where the 19 October evidence is out of date against dbe0e02 (not used): amount is typed string | number, not string only (the guide's “the amount as text” still holds as advice: a number is shown unformatted too); Balance now has testID, accessibilityLabel and the View props (the dbe0e02 section says so); slot cloning is Balance's own cloneCoinSlotChildren (Balance.tsx:21-59), not react-utils' cloneChildrenWithModes, and it skips strings, host elements, View and Text and recurses into fragments, so “A non-Coin child gets a stray modes prop” now holds only for non-Coin function or class components; “No mode changes the title” and “the title stays #0c0d10” under JioPlus are replaced by the dbe0e02 section; the source comment the evidence cites as Balance.tsx:92-94 is now at lines 151-153. Not recorded: Balance and MoneyValue read modes only from their own props, never from JFSThemeProvider (the evidence's “The toolbar's Color Mode does nothing to Balance”, still true on dbe0e02), so a Color Mode set once at the app root, as the building rules expect, does not reach a Balance; and under Color Mode Dark the title stays #0c0d10 over a #fff5e8 amount. Both are dark mode, which the pack's rules keep out of gaps; reported to the run. Also not recorded: style, testID and accessibilityLabel (the guide doesn't cover them; the building rules keep style off Coin components), the data-node-id and Storybook decorator details, and the evidence's Usages (PortfolioHero, StatusHero and RechargeCard use Money Value directly). Anatomy: Currency and Amount are the Money Value's parts; with children your own Money Value supplies them; they are marked required because the guide's slot is for a Money Value and the defaults always fill them. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode and no Context3 (the guide sets none on its own Balances, and no guide sentence says which content needs which amount size); the In context VStacks drop the guide's Padding, Slot gap and Stack Context modes, and the Settle up Button keeps its defaults (the main action) and drops the guide's alignSelf stretch style, since a VStack stretches its children by default (stackAlignment.ts). MoneyValue has no entry in this pack; the hidden example uses it because the guide's Configuration passes one through children for the hidden option (as the ActionTile entry uses IconCapsule), and it carries no modes since the Balance passes its own. Copy is the guide's own (Goa trip, 4 friends · 12 expenses, Total owed to people, 2,450.00, Settle up; Total owed to you, 1,250.00, USD; Available balance, 50,000.67, INR); the press handler is a stub; no image sources. Left out of examples (the pack allows three): Negative amount, Nothing owed, the Context3 size previews, the Content's A complete balance, the playground and its readouts, and the Don'ts. Gaps are the three the Sources note states: Figma's single Title property against the code props, the 68 px against 60 px height, and the published Storybook docs page that still doesn't load (#346's Controls import, fixed in Biscuit's source, hosted Storybook not redeployed). Sorting (batch 7): the cross-check found that the Settle up item generalised the trip example into a rule for any action and added a placement the guide does not state; it now keeps the example’s context. It also found Currency marked always present, and children replace the default Money Value (Configuration); Currency is now not required. A second cross-check found that “a hidden amount shows no symbol”, added to its holds, was read off one specimen; it is removed. Refreshed 29 October 2026 for guide fix #543 (3f56271): the evidence's Storybook line now says the custom slot's MoneyValue has a grey rounded background; no sentence quoted here changed, so only the guide commit moves.
